info.bio:
Lubricated Goat was an Australian noise rock band of the 1980s. They achieved brief notoriety for playing on a television program naked, with only their instruments. Mainly influenced by bands like The Stooges and The Birthday Party, they are credited for playing a grimy, confrontational style of rock which preceded grunge and 1990s noise rock.

Lubricated Goat was formed by Stu Spasm (real name Stuart Grey). Spasm had previously been in bands such as Singing Dog with Nick Barker, and Salamander Jim with Tex Perkins.

scenes.desc: El hardcore más salvaje y ruidoso de finales de los ochenta sale de los Grandes Lagos, donde el legado de MC5 y Stooges seguía vivo: Die Kreuzen, Killdozer, los Laughing Hyenas de John Brannon (You Can't Pray A Lie, «teatro del horror, el miedo y el odio»), los Cows de Minneapolis (payasos y delincuentes a la vez), Lazy Cowgirls, Death Of Samantha y Cobra Verde, Phantom 309, Scrawl. En Australia, King Snake Roost y los Lubricated Goat de Stu Spasm.
